stories.title: Token Revocation API and Admin Control
stories.description: Implement secured API endpoints and internal admin controls to revoke bearer tokens by setting revoked_flag and immediately denying further use. Ensure compatibility with existing auth middleware.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; Code/Shared/brain_auth.py; GAP: No revocation endpoint or admin control exists

stories.title: Lifecycle Enforcement Integration in GPTReader
stories.description: Integrate rotation, expiration, and revocation checks into GPTReader request flow to ensure all incoming requests validate token lifecycle state before data access is granted.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Test Suite (Unit + Integration)
stories.description: Develop comprehensive test coverage for token lifecycle including rotation correctness, expiration enforcement, revocation behavior, and GPTReader integration paths. Include edge cases such as race conditions and expired-but-not-revoked tokens.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/tests/test_gpt_reader.py; Code/DataPipelines/tests/test_gpt_reader_integration.py; GAP: No lifecycle-specific test coverage exists
